one_line: A devoted lay attendant who tends the sick in early Buddhist monastic infirmaries and charitable houses along the pilgrim routes of ancient India.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but sturdy build from daily physical work
appearance.face: oval face with warm brown complexion, gentle almond eyes, straight nose, faint stubble shadow on the jaw, and a few small burnished scars on the hands and cheek; default expression is calm, compassionate focus with a slight reassuring smile
appearance.hair: black hair pulled into a neat low knot at the back of the head, with a narrow off‑white cloth band (simple headwrap strip) tied around the forehead to keep hair back, no ornaments
appearance.costume: A practical layman’s outfit inspired by early historic Gangetic plain dress: an under‑tunic of undyed off‑white cotton reaching mid‑thigh with short, simple sleeves; over it a wrapped lower garment (dhoti-like) in muted dusty‑brown cotton, pleated in front and tied at the waist, falling to the ankles; a saffron‑tinged light‑brown cotton shawl draped from left shoulder across chest and around back, easy to pull over the head when moving between wards; narrow dark‑brown cloth belt holding a small pouch; simple leather‑like sandals; no metal armor, only a string of plain wooden beads at the neck, and a folded, neatly rolled extra bandage cloth looped at his waist for readiness
appearance.signature: A shallow, wide clay medicine tray carried in both hands, with small oil lamps and three distinct little clay bowls containing ghee, herbal pastes, and pills, plus a neatly folded strip of bandage cloth resting on the rim

ref_desc: A lean early‑30s lay infirmary keeper with an oval warm‑brown face, black hair in a low knot with an off‑white headband, wearing an off‑white tunic, dusty‑brown ankle‑length wrap, saffron‑brown shawl, dark‑brown belt and sandals, and carrying a clay medicine tray with lamps and bowls.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of a male Buddhist infirmary keeper from early historic India: early 30s, lean but sturdy, oval warm‑brown face with gentle almond eyes, straight nose, faint stubble shadow and a few small work scars, default expression calm and compassionate with a slight reassuring smile. His black hair is pulled into a neat low knot at the back, held in place by a narrow off‑white cloth band tied around his forehead. He wears an undyed off‑white cotton tunic to mid‑thigh with short sleeves, a dusty‑brown wrapped lower garment like a dhoti pleated in front and falling to the ankles, and a light saffron‑brown cotton shawl draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back, looking soft and practical, not luxurious. A narrow dark‑brown cloth belt at his waist holds a small pouch and a neatly rolled strip of spare bandage cloth, and he has simple leather‑like dark‑brown sandals on his feet; at his neck is a single string of plain wooden prayer beads. His hands are slightly calloused and gentle. His signature prop is a shallow wide clay medicine tray carried in both hands, containing tiny burning oil lamps and three small clay bowls with ghee, herbal paste, and pills, plus a folded strip of bandage cloth resting on the rim. Use a muted palette of off‑white, dusty brown, saffron brown, and dark brown, and show him from head to toe with clear views of his face, hair, clothing layers, and medicine tray so the character can be consistently redrawn.
